Summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021 F-150 vehicles.  The electronic brake booster may leak brake fluid into the electronic control unit, which could result in reduced braking performance.
Consequence: Reduced braking performance can increase the risk of a crash.
Remedy: Dealers will replace the electronic brake booster assembly, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on July 28, 2021.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 21S33.
Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.
